input.report: NCR-2041. Part 88-3312-B mounting bracket, supplier lot L26091 from Kestrel Metalworks. Flange thickness measured 2.68 to 2.74 mm on all 6 sampled pieces against the drawing callout of 3.0 mm +/- 0.1 mm. Found at incoming inspection, receiving dock 2, during the standard AQL sample on 2026-09-22. Lot quantity received: 1,200 pieces; the whole lot is suspect since every sample failed. Requesting disposition from engineering.
